title: Pin web CI to the runner handoff digest
rationale: The web consumer uses a container image pinned by @sha256 rather than a mutable tag; the workflow comment and companion document point reviewers to NacoSolutions/senshac-runner PR #21 and its exported handoff.

title: Repair the web consumer after the published runner digest changed
rationale: The merged senshac-web handoff referenced an unavailable runner digest and failed with manifest unknown. The consumer must pin the digest actually published by successful workflow 35214744376, ghcr.io/nacosolutions/senshac-runner@sha256:681eb70b649ad6af34cc70b5abc1944276db015f17c73625423b3cbbc07421ab, while retaining immutable-reference contract checks.
